Hi Priya / Daniel —

Great to meet last week. This thread kicks off the onboarding plan for Verdant Labs' quality monitoring (prompt sets, eval harness integration, regression alerts, and canary/rollback policies). I attached the first draft of the prompt set and the mutual action plan so we have a single source for owners and timelines.

High-level ask for this thread: please review the attached prompt set CSV and the MAP, confirm owners on your side, and flag any legal / procurement blockers we should address before we schedule the technical kickoff.

Planned deliverables & milestones:
- Prompt sets v1 (attached) — initial 150 prompts mapped to product flows (owner: Verdant) — target: 2026-12-10
- Eval harness integration guide (attached) — our recommended webhook/S3 ingestion and sample scoring pipeline (owner: Redwood infra) — target: 2026-12-12
- Canary policy & rollback thresholds — draft below; review & signoff by 2026-12-14
- Technical kickoff meeting — propose Mon 2026-12-07 10:00 PST (30m)

Suggested canary/rollback (high-level draft):
- Canary traffic: 5% of production requests routed to canary model variant.
- Canary duration: minimum 4 hours of steady traffic, with at least 500 relevant completions for the critical promptset.
- Regression trigger: >5% degradation in primary quality metric (average top-1 accuracy on critical promptset) OR any critical safety false positive detected.
- Automatic rollback: if regression trigger fired and manual triage not completed within 2 hours, rollback to previous stable variant.

Questions for Verdant:
1) Which prompts should be considered "critical" for the initial canary? (we highlighted suggestions in the CSV)
2) Any restrictions on telemetry export (S3 bucket / region / encryption specs)?
3) Preferred MRR/contract milestone we should align the rollout to?

Attachments: verdant_qmon_promptset_v1.csv, eval-harness-integration-guide.pdf, mutual-action-plan-verdant.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround. Happy to demo the harness in the kickoff. A few technical clarifications up front so we don't block the meeting:

Eval harness integration (how we recommend Verdant connect):
- Ingest options: 1) S3 drop (preferred for large batches) 2) Webhook streaming for real-time scoring (requires signed JWT).
- Payload: minimal envelope {request_id, input_text, meta: {flow, user_tier}}. We strip PII on ingest if flagged by customer metadata, but customer-side redaction is still required for contract.
- Storage: results are written to a customer S3 bucket in us-west-2 with SSE-KMS and lifecycle rules; we support versioned buckets.
- Alerting: Redwood creates regression alerts in Slack + PagerDuty if thresholds are crossed.

Proposed canary configuration (concrete):
- Canary variant: model-x-1.1-quant (lower cost variant)
- Traffic split: 95% baseline / 5% canary
- Minimum sample threshold: 500 completions for the critical promptset over a rolling 4-hour window
- Primary quality metric: weighted average of intent accuracy and hallucination reduction score (we'll provide the scoring script).
- Regression threshold: relative drop >5% vs baseline on the weighted metric OR any single critical prompt with failure rate >10%.
- Rollback action: automatic rollback + incident created in Jira if trigger occurs; manual hold enabled if Verdant requests triage window.

Owners & immediate next steps (who does what):
- Verdant: finalize critical promptset (Priya) — due 2026-12-07
- Redwood infra: set up S3 ingestion + sample harness (Rishi) — target 2026-12-12
- CS: schedule kickoff + own MAP coordination (Marissa) — schedule by 2026-12-06
- Security: exchange SOC2/attestation via secure link (Marissa / Verdant procurement) — target 2026-12-09

I'll prepare a 10-minute demo flow showing a sample payload through the eval harness and the resulting evaluation run, including how we compute the weighted metric.

-Rishi
